overview: Home at Great St Helen's after Richard's birthday supper at the Jackdaw, you set down the full vote of all eight men in the tiring-house, Kemp's lone dissent, Pope making you own that August is for the pages, and the jaw that sent you home at nine.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the late-night note at Great St Helen's after returning from the Jackdaw.

parties.name: John Heminges
parties.context: Carried the vote and entered the three dates with no sum under them.

parties.name: Will Kemp
parties.context: Stood alone against resting the house in August.

parties.name: Thomas Pope
parties.context: Forced William to admit August suits him better than hired men.

parties.name: George Bryan
parties.context: Put a constable and my lord's warrant on every mile of the road.

parties.name: James Burbage
parties.context: Took the twenty-sixth to keep his house earning.

parties.name: Richard Burbage
parties.context: Asked for three clear weeks in August to con the King and received the pearwood glass.

parties.name: Augustine Phillips
parties.context: Sat his chest silent at the vote and sang at the Jackdaw.

key_provisions.text: the month is for the pages
